context: Production Release Readback returned reproducible HTTP 503 for /api/connectors/readiness while Netlify exposed both the exact public readiness route and the protected /api/connectors/* wildcard.
symptom: Production readiness check failed with HTTP 503 on repeated readback attempts.
root_cause_class: routing configuration collision risk between an exact public health endpoint and an authenticated wildcard surface
causal_caveat: The overlapping routes were directly observable and the explicit isolation plus fresh deployment removed the reproducible 503. No historical per-invocation runtime log proved wildcard shadowing was the only possible cause, so do not overstate exclusivity.

fix.pattern: Explicitly exclude /api/connectors/readiness from the protected /api/connectors/* wildcard while preserving the dedicated connector-readiness exact route.
fix.security: All other connector routes remain protected; readiness and auth checks were not weakened.

production_evidence.route_readback: portal-connectors wildcard contains an explicit exclusion for /api/connectors/readiness and connector-readiness owns the exact route

reuse_rule: For Netlify exact-route plus wildcard combinations, inspect deployed route metadata and make public health/readiness exclusions explicit before claiming production readiness.
